7.t: The following information includes the necessary retrofit instructions for changing the Gravitar upright game into a Black Widow game. The modifications include changing the cabinet graphics, the control panel, the harness assembly, certain game board components, and the self-test label. Information is also provided for changing the Gravitar Schematic Package Supplement (SP-206) to reflect the Black Widow circuitry.

Check the contents of the Black Widow Retrofit Kit (A040037-01) before proceeding with the retrofit procedure. Note that the integrated circuit (IC) components included in the retrofit kit are labeled with their respective part numbers. The parts included in this retrofit kit are listed in Table 1.
TM-234   L   Black Widow Operators Manual
62-039   2   SPDT momentary pushbutton start switch with

8.t: The tools listed in Table 2 (or their equivalents) are required to performa complete retrofit modification.
1   Phillips-head screwdriver   Remove access panel and PCB
1   16-27 W soldering iron   Install PCB components
These procedures mist be performed by qualified service personnel.

The following procedures are arranged in a sequence recommended for performing the retrofit modification. The parts of the Gravitar game that are affected by the modification (see Figure 1) are removed first. Next, the game PCB is modified. Then, the modified PCB and the remaining kit parts are installed.
